# STONZA

> STONZA is an original stones and gemstone jewelry store based in Pakistan,
> selling authentic natural stones (aqeeq/agate, feroza/turquoise, ruby,
> emerald, sapphire, and other gems) set in sterling silver jewelry, with
> select fancy jewellery sets finished in gold plating. Every listing
> discloses provenance, treatment, and authenticity details.

STONZA sells directly to consumers online at https://stonza.pk. Products are
organized by stone type, jewelry category (rings, bracelets, jewellery sets),
and curated collections. Each product page states the stone's origin, cut,
clarity, carat weight, and treatment, and includes a certificate reference
where available. Orders ship within Pakistan with WhatsApp-based customer
support.

## Shop
- [All Stones & Jewelry](https://stonza.pk/shop): the full catalog of original stones, gemstones, and silver jewelry.
- [Original Stones](https://stonza.pk/categories/stones): loose, natural gemstones for collectors and custom jewellers.
- [Men's Jewelry](https://stonza.pk/categories/men): silver jewelry rings, bracelets, and chains.
- [Women's Jewelry](https://stonza.pk/categories/women): silver jewelry rings, bracelets, and fancy jewellery sets.
- [Fancy Jewellery Sets](https://stonza.pk/categories/women-jewellery-sets): matching gemstone jewelry sets in sterling silver with gold-plated filigree.
- [Collections](https://stonza.pk/collections): curated groupings of original stones and gemstone jewelry.
